move: five blurred colour blobs orbit Lissajous paths, hue rotates once per loop
how: A 2D canvas paints a deep purple ground, then five additive (lighter) radial gradients under ctx.filter blur(40px), each moving on a closed Lissajous path (integer fx/fy multiples of the loop phase) with a hue that turns a full 360 degrees over D so t=D is pixel-identical to t=0. A multiply vignette keeps the corners dark and a static seeded film-grain canvas sits over it at 7% overlay. A small white circle-and-wordmark lockup sits bottom-left and does not move.
adapt: Change the ground colour, the base hues and radii in the blobs array, the lockup text, and drop or keep the grain; keep the integer Lissajous frequencies and the 360-degree hue turn per loop or the loop will no longer close.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the two canvases and the lockup inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with a single tween on {u:0->1, ease:none, duration:D} whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) paint (the fx.register loop). Canvas is fixed 1280x720; scale via CSS or read el size.
caveats: ctx.filter blur(40px) on five large radial fills per frame is slow to render
the grain canvas fills 1280x720 ImageData once at mount
